note: P3969 (Pro 13:23) — the fallow ground of the poor would yield much food, but it is swept away through injustice.

dims.v: poverty — the poor whose potential harvest injustice sweeps away
the poor whose fallow ground could yield much, but is swept away by injustice
the poor's lost potential, stolen by injustice

rush (be poor) — 'the fallow ground of the POOR would yield much food, but it is swept away through injustice'; the poor's potential is real but robbed by wrong. The read notes the injustice that keeps the poor poor — not sloth but oppression.
